summary: cpwshop site pages: 35 electric sites, all 50 A, all listed to 50 ft, 7 pull-throughs, no water/sewer at the site. Added site count 35, max rig 50, pull-through, season May 1 - Nov 1 (was year_round false only), booking url and 14-in-28 limit; confirmed 50 A, showers/flush/laundry/dump, reservable. Fees unchanged ($36 electric, 2026-10-12 read). The camping page does not restate the six-month window (left inherited). Note trimmed.
flags: The park's other camping (East Cross Mountain 2 sites, Deerlodge Park 7 (NPS), Duffy Mountain 1, Juniper Canyon 5, Maybell Bridge 6) is described by CPW as primitive river-access sites with kiosk permits; none is a developed drive-in RV campground, so no missing entry.
Pin is ~16 m from the centroid of the 35 electric sites (40.49055,-107.31029). Fine.
Potable water: the note's 'water at the entrance' is not stated on CPW's page; the stored potable_water (derived) was left as is.
Open now (season runs to Nov 1); CPW's only alert is low river flow for boaters.
